## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] New logic has tests beside it; UI changes keep the axe test green
- [ ] Copy lives in `src/content/`, colours come from tokens, no file over ~150 lines without reason
- [ ] No trust rule broken ([docs/product/trust-rules.md](../docs/product/trust-rules.md))
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, env vars, data model or the phase plan changed
- [ ] Auth, token or encryption changes reviewed by a person
